text:
Sam (PM): Quick thread to finalize a compact pilot intake + contract template. Goal: onboard 2 beta partners in 6 weeks with minimal friction.
Ravi (Eng): Suggest MVE constraints up front: no custom weights, only verified open models, and limited request concurrency for pilot. Keeps infra predictable.
Lina (CS): I'll prioritize candidates who already run trials. Screening q's should be 5 fields max.
Marta (Design): Feedback loop proposal: 15-min unmoderated task, then one 45-min moderated session. Also a 3-question micro-survey after each session.
Evan (SRE): Ops gates: must have SSO or approved auth flow, provide sanitized sample payloads, and sign security questionnaire. We'll validate KMS connectivity in staging.
Sam (PM): Draft MVE acceptance criteria (high-level):
```
- run at least 500 inferences/day for 10 business days
- p95 latency within target for chosen model (baseline: <200ms)
- no critical security findings from questionnaire
- partner completes 2 feedback sessions and micro-surveys
```
Ravi (Eng): Telemetry hooks I will add: per-route p95, model-variant tag, error rate percent. Also expose a lightweight deploy-rollback switch.
Lina (CS): Intake form fields (minimal): company, contact, compliance needs (DPA/KMS/SSO), expected daily tokens, readiness for VPC/on-prem (yes/no), preferred onboarding weeks.
Marta (Design): Micro-survey: 3 quick Likert q's + one open text. I'll post a Notion page with the script.
Evan (SRE): Rollout fallback: if error rate >1% or p95 spikes x2 for 3 consecutive minutes -> auto-shift traffic to hosted-safe variant and alert oncall. We'll simulate this in staging.
Sam (PM): Action items: Ravi -> tech checklist + telemetry (3 days). Lina -> intake form + candidate outreach (2 days). Marta -> session script + survey (2 days). Evan -> ops gating doc and rollback test (3 days). I'll stitch together the partner contract template with rollback SLA.
ci-bot: staging-pilot cluster provisioned at https://internal.console/pilot-staging (image: rwd/pilot-2026).
Lina (CS): I'll start outreach tonight to 8 candidates, will surface 4 with highest match.
Ravi (Eng): One more constraint: no model fine-tuning during pilot to avoid data isolation work. Keep we "inference-only".
Sam (PM): Noted. We'll capture that in the agreement. Quick sync in 4 days to review intake form + checklist. Ping @legal for contract review. :white_check_mark:
